integrity: Entire result has a self-contained proof; direct computations for 975 finite pairs are supporting tests rather than proof for infinite parameters. Priority is a same-model best-knowledge assessment, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact maximal consecutive-gap run spectrum only for quotients <pk+1,pk+2>/p (integers p>=2, k>=1). Known quotient-semigroup algorithms may imply global genus or Frobenius special cases. Unindexed or implicit earlier equivalent run spectra cannot be excluded.
title: A uniform gap-run spectrum for quotients of consecutive-generator numerical semigroups
